reviews.summary: Clean implementation of Ctrl+S save shortcut with TextInput/modal suppression, window minimize/restore, occluded handling, and save feedback. 3 unit tests added. Two non-blocking issues noted: Occluded handler discards recreate_swapchain return value (negligible practical impact), and keyboard suppression test only asserts boolean flag.

Well-architected interactive inspector with InspectorEditState pattern. Transform editing has real-time viewport updates. Four non-blocking issues: PointLight/ParticleEmitter deferred by one frame, redundant double-write for Transform, no commit-on-release behavior, and fully-qualified type path.

Four integration tests covering all required cross-area assertions (VAL-CROSS-002/003/004/007). Tests use real APIs, follow existing patterns, and include thorough assertions. One non-blocking observation about f32::EPSILON usage.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document the prev_want_capture_keyboard pattern for keyboard shortcut suppression: save want_capture_keyboard after UI rendering, check it in the next frame's event handler. This one-frame delay is imperceptible and avoids race conditions between event processing and UI rendering.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: editor-ctrl-s-and-minimize review: the pattern is used for Ctrl+S suppression but only documented in a code comment, not in AGENTS.md or library.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add note about recreate_swapchain return value handling inconsistency: Resized handler processes returned texture slots, Occluded handler discards them. Viewport bindless index is safe (updated every frame), but shadow atlas views could become stale after occluded restore.

Document the katla_ui Slider widget idiomatic pattern: Slider::new(&mut value, range) mutates value directly during ui.add(). Response has .changed and .active fields for event handling. This is the standard pattern for inspector-style controls.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: inspector-inline-editing review: worker discovered the pattern but it isn't documented in AGENTS.md or library.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Document ECS query_changed tuple arity: query_changed::<(&T, &U)>() returns (EntityId, &T, &U) — a 3-tuple including EntityId, not a 2-tuple. Also document that component_events_for::<T>() returns Vec<&ComponentEvent> (owned Vec of references) requiring binding to a variable before iteration.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: cross-area-integration-tests review: worker encountered compile errors for both patterns and had to fix destructuring and borrow checker issues.
